assets.title: Bank-to-Plateau Escarpment Transition
assets.description: Original S02 steep bank-to-plateau terrain transition with two unequal cliff ledges, angular fracture facets, low earth apron and broad upper earth shoulder. One continuous closed editable mesh, 2 m X repeat, 1.60 m landward depth and approximately 1.70 m total height. At placement (0,1.2,0), the complete local Y=0 front cap matches the original straight bank landward boundary, including its .55/.58/.55 m rim at X=-1/0/+1. Full boundary agreement and finite opposed contact are verified for this one placement within 2e-6 m positional tolerance. X=-1 and +1 sections repeat with another copy translated 2 m along X. Legacy earth PBR is retained on the low apron; stone values follow coherent cliff planes. Local origin is the low-front boundary centre at ground Z=0. No water geometry, whole-scene or curved-bank snapping, walkability, navigation, collision mesh, dynamic terrain, physics or engineering certification.
